page.overview:
Who is Alberich Haupt-Anderssen?

Alberich Haupt-Anderssen, who reigned as Alberich V, Grand Count of Stirland, Prince of Wurtbad and Overlord of Sylvania, is the graf and Elector Count of the Imperial Grand Province of Stirland.

By the time of the Turmoil of 2512, Alberich was 15 years old. He had no heirs at the time, as his younger brother Rudolph Haupt-Anderssen had been disinherited in 2511 IC by Stirmarshal Haygich, Alberich's regent.

During the civil unrest that plagued the Empire in the Turmoil of 2512, Alberich kept his province out of the fighting and was one of the first Elector Counts to side with Emperor Karl Franz. For this show of loyalty, he was granted the title of grand count. Alberich also supported the restoration of Nordland as a full Electoral Province of the Empire.

When hostilities erupted between Graf Alberich Haupt-Anderssen of Stirland and Helmut Feuerbach of Talabecland, ancestral enemies since the Age of Three Emperors, the other Elector Counts waited expectantly to see which side the Emperor Karl Franz would back.
